questions.question: Create a series of experimental studies exploring 3d form and sculpture techniques. Annotate your process.

points.text: A range of experimental studies showing different approaches to 3d form and sculpture techniques, each annotated with media, technique and purpose. Show development from initial experiments to refined outcomes.

questions.question: Research an artist or designer who works with 3d form and sculpture techniques. Write a critical analysis of their approach and explain how it has informed your own work.

points.text: A critical analysis naming a specific artist/designer, using specialist vocabulary, explaining their context and approach, and making clear connections to personal work.

questions.question: Evaluate the effectiveness of your experiments with 3d form and sculpture techniques. Which approaches were most successful and why?

points.text: A reflective evaluation identifying successful and less successful experiments, explaining WHY using technical and conceptual language, and showing how evaluation led to further refinement.

points.text: A grade 9 response will: show confident use of multiple techniques; document the full making process; evaluate technical challenges and how they were overcome; explain how material properties influenced decisions; make connections to sculptors studied.
